userDirection: Build and maintain the ETS-owned SensorML validator until an upstream reusable module is made.

currentExternalState.etsSensorMl30Role: official upstream ETS source evidence only

firstPartyBackend.maintainedUntil: A reusable upstream SensorML validator module is available and passes all replacement gates.

replacementGates: Public source repository or accepted artifact coordinates are available.
Commit, branch or tag provenance is reproducible and source-pinned.
The module exposes a reusable non-TestNG validator API.
The module is not the executable ets-sensorml30 TeamEngine suite jar.
License and dependency closure are compatible with the ETS runtime.
Valid and invalid fixture parity matches the first-party corpus for every closed SensorML target.
Diagnostics are deterministic, immutable from the ETS boundary, and backend-neutral.
Operational schema or configuration failures remain suite errors, not IUT conformance failures.
TeamEngine 6 final-image runtime closure shows no duplicate or conflicting dependency families.
Local OSH TeamEngine E2E runs against a real IUT and records exact totals before replacement is accepted.
disallowedShortcuts: Importing org.opengis.cite:ets-sensorml30 as a library dependency.
Counting source similarity as validator parity without valid and invalid fixture results.
Letting NetworkNT, TestNG or upstream validator runtime result types escape the adapter API.
Removing the first-party backend before a replacement passes parity, diagnostics, runtime and E2E review.
